rag.text:
Test: TC-561 — Feature area - Resource - Team - Resynchronize with Tempo
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-86 Feature area - Resource - Team
Labels: be-enterprise

Steps:
1. Navigate to Tempo -> Teams
   Data: _Tempo_ should be installed
   Expected: Teams tab is displayed
2. Click +Create team button
   Expected: Additional window to create team appears
3. Create new team passing this set of data
   Data: name: TC-561 Team to resynchronize
   Expected: Team is created
4. Navigate to Global Teams module of BP Main Box
   Expected: Global Teams module is displayed
5. Click on Teams button in the header menu, hover over Synchronize, select Synhronize with Tempo, accept by clicking on Proceed button and check visibility
   Expected: Team "TC-561 Team to resynchronize" is displayed with green Tempo lozenge
6. Click on the teamName and in Details tab of sidebar set newName
Click on Save button
   Data: teamName: TC-561 Team to resynchronize
newName: TC-561 Team edited on BP level
   Expected: Changes are saved. 

Team is overwritten on BP level.
7. Navigate to Tempo -> Teams
   Expected: Teams tab is displayed. "TC-561 Team to resynchronize" is displayed. 

Changes made in BP level are not visible in Tempo.
8. Click on teamName
   Expected: Detail view of "TC-561 Team to resynchronize" is displayed
9. Click on Name field and set newName

Click Enter
   Data: newName: TC-561 Team resynchronized
   Expected: Changes are saved
10. Navigate to Global Teams module of BP Main Box
   Expected: Global Teams module is displayed
11. Click on Teams button in the header menu, hover over Synchronize, select Synhronize with Tempo, accept by clicking on Proceed button and check visibility
   Expected: "TC-561 Team edited on BP level" is still displayed on the list. 

Additional resynchronize icon is displayed next to team name.
12. Click Resynchronize button and check visibility after refresh
   Expected: Teams are resynchronized. "TC-561 Team resynchronized" is now displayed on the list with green Tempo lozenge
